cpo.name: Sagelio SRL Societa Benefit

inventoryEvidence.officialNetworkStatement: Sagelio states over 400 charging points active across Italy.

positiveEvidence: Sagelio official site describes pricing as a control available to each host/location ('Controllo totale sui guadagni — Pricing, monitoraggio e reporting'), which is evidence against assuming one deterministic network-wide retail tariff.
Official site states network exceeds 400 charging points and includes both AC and Fast DC deployments.
Fresh PUN-derived Pienotto pages for multiple IT*SAG EVSE state tariffs have not been communicated to PUN.
Fresh station discovery shows heterogeneous IT*SAG power classes including 8/11/22 kW AC and 90/120 kW DC.
negativeEvidence: No current official network-wide Sagelio driver tariff found in this pass.
PUN-derived records inspected expose no tariff for sampled IT*SAG EVSE.
No deterministic mapping from power class alone to direct/ad-hoc retail price established.
cpo.decision: Keep fail-closed and station-level. Do not infer a network-wide or class-wide price. Sagelio's own host proposition explicitly exposes pricing control, so station/location-specific pricing is plausible and must be resolved through a station payment surface or tariff-bearing backend.
cpo.resumeCondition: Obtain a deterministic IT*SAG EVSE -> direct payment/QR/app/backend tariff mapping, or discover an official rule constraining host-set pricing to deterministic classes.
cpo.confidence: high for station-level classification; no confidence assigned to an energy price
